title: Highly prone to mold
text: Highly prone to mold. I would caution against buying this.  Not sure what material this is made from, but the grooves in the lid are highly prone to mold and does not keep beverages cold for long. Also, because of the ultra-thin band of metal, you cannot put this in the microwave if you want a hot beverage. The silicone straw is unusable - it is a super flimsy silicone that collapses at the slightest pressure. I threw it away.
